entries.title: Aberration (ABBER)
entries.summary: A moving average with bands set a multiple of the average absolute deviation away, so the channel widens with typical distance from the mean.

entries.title: Accelerator Oscillator (AC)
entries.summary: Measures whether momentum is speeding up or slowing down: the midpoint momentum oscillator less its own five-bar average.

entries.title: Acceleration Bands (ACCBANDS)
entries.summary: An average of the close with bands pushed beyond the averaged high and low by a multiple of the average bar spread.

entries.title: Acceleration (Slope of Slope) (ACCEL)
entries.summary: The slope of a rolling regression slope: how fast the trend of the source is itself speeding up or slowing down, bar by bar.

entries.title: Accumulation/Distribution Line (ADL)
entries.summary: A running total of volume weighted by where each bar closes within its range, tracking buying and selling pressure over time.

entries.title: Chaikin A/D Oscillator (ADOSC)
entries.summary: The gap between a fast and a slow exponential average of the accumulation/distribution line, showing shifts in money flow momentum.

entries.title: Average Daily Range (ADR)
entries.summary: Averages the plain high-minus-low range of each bar, with a choice of simple, exponential or weighted smoothing, to show how far price travels in a bar.

entries.title: Average Directional Movement Index (ADX)
entries.summary: Plots ADX with the +DI and -DI lines from running totals that subtract their own earlier value, a recursion that leaves the usual ranges soon after the first period.

entries.title: Average Directional Movement Index Rating (ADXR)
entries.summary: Averages today's ADX with the ADX from a set number of bars earlier, a steadier read of trend strength drawn with ADX, +DI and -DI.

entries.title: ADX Variable Moving Average (ADXVMA)
entries.summary: An adaptive average that uses the ADX as its smoothing factor, following price closely in a strong trend and flattening in a range.

entries.title: Autoregressive FIR Moving Average (AFIRMA)
entries.summary: A cosine-windowed moving average of recent prices; with the least squares option on, it becomes a plain simple average of the window.

entries.title: Ehlers Automatic Gain Control (AGC)
entries.summary: A roofing filter that isolates the price cycle, scaled by its own decaying peak so the oscillator always swings between -1 and +1.

entries.title: Ahrens Moving Average (AHRENS)
entries.summary: A recursive average that steps toward price from the midpoint of its previous value and its value one period ago.

entries.title: Ehlers Adaptive Laguerre Filter (ALAGUERRE)
entries.summary: A four-stage Laguerre smoother whose speed adapts bar by bar to how far it has fallen behind price, speeding up in moves and slowing in ranges.

entries.title: Williams Alligator
entries.summary: Three smoothed averages of different lengths, each shifted forward by its own number of bars, whose spacing shows trend or rest.

entries.title: Arnaud Legoux Moving Average (ALMA)
entries.summary: A Gaussian-weighted moving average whose peak weight can slide from the middle of the window toward the newest bar.

entries.title: Archer Moving Averages Trends (AMAT)
entries.summary: Flags a bar as trending only when a fast and a slow exponential average agree on both their order and their direction, and measures their spread.

entries.title: Awesome Oscillator (AO)
entries.summary: Plots the fast simple average of the bar midpoint minus the slow one, coloured green while it is rising or flat and red while it is falling.

entries.title: AOBV - Archer On-Balance Volume (AOBV)
entries.summary: Two smoothed lines of on-balance volume, a fast and a slow, that read accumulation and distribution from the first bar.

entries.title: Andrews' Pitchfork (AP)
entries.summary: Three parallel lines projected from three pivot points read a fixed number of bars back, recomputed on every bar.

entries.title: Absolute Price Oscillator (APO)
entries.summary: Plots the gap between a fast and a slow exponential average in price units, with a correction that removes the starting bias on early bars.

entries.title: Adaptive Price Zone
entries.summary: A double smoothed average of price with a zone around it sized by the double smoothed bar range.

entries.title: Aroon (AROON)
entries.summary: Two lines from 0 to 100 that show how recently the window's highest high and lowest low were set, to judge whether a trend is fresh or fading.

entries.title: Aroon Oscillator
entries.summary: Aroon Up minus Aroon Down in one line between -100 and +100, with the pane shaded green above zero and red below to show which extreme is fresher.

entries.title: Accumulation Swing Index (ASI)
entries.summary: A running total of each bar's swing index, a score of how strongly the close moved against the previous bar, scaled by the bar's range.

entries.title: Two-Argument Arctangent (ATAN2)
entries.summary: Plots the angle, in radians from -pi to pi, of the point formed by two chosen bar values, keeping the sign of each in all four quadrants.

entries.title: Average True Range (ATR)
entries.summary: Measures how far price typically travels in one bar, counting any gap from the previous close, as a smoothed average of the true range.

entries.title: ATR Bands (ATRBANDS)
entries.summary: A simple average of the source with bands a multiple of the average true range above and below it.

entries.title: Average True Range Normalized (ATRN)
entries.summary: Places the current average true range inside its own range over the last ten lengths of bars, from 0 at the lowest to 1 at the highest.

entries.title: Average True Range Percent (ATRP)
entries.summary: The average true range divided by the close and shown as a percentage, so volatility can be compared across instruments and price levels.

entries.title: AVGPRICE: Average Price
entries.summary: The plain mean of each bar's open, high, low and close, drawn on the price chart as one number for where the bar traded.

entries.title: Baxter-King Band-Pass Filter (BAXTERKING)
entries.summary: A centred, zero-sum band-pass filter on the close that keeps only cycles between two periods and oscillates around zero.

entries.title: Bollinger Bands (BBANDS)
entries.summary: A simple average with bands a multiple of the population standard deviation away, drawn from the first bar on an expanding window.

entries.title: Bollinger %B
entries.summary: Shows where price sits inside its own Bollinger Bands, with 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper band and readings beyond them outside the bands.

entries.title: Bulls Bears Index (BBI)
entries.summary: One line on the price chart that averages four simple moving averages of different lengths, blending very short, short, medium and long trend.

entries.title: Bollinger Band Squeeze (BBS)
entries.summary: Draws Bollinger Bands and Keltner Channels on price and marks every bar where the bands sit entirely inside the channels, the low-volatility squeeze.

entries.title: Bollinger Band Width (BBW)
entries.summary: The distance between upper and lower deviation bands around a moving mean, in price units, a direct measure of how spread out recent prices are.

entries.title: Bollinger Band Width Normalized (BBWN)
entries.summary: Rescales the current band width inside its own range over a lookback window, from 0 at the narrowest to 1 at the widest.

entries.title: Bollinger Band Width Percentile (BBWP)
entries.summary: The share of recent band widths that are narrower than the current one, a 0 to 1 rank of how expanded the bands are now.

entries.title: Bessel 2nd Order Filter (BESSEL)
entries.summary: A two-pole recursive lowpass smoother with Bessel-style coefficients, giving a smooth price line with a steady, predictable lag.

entries.title: Beta Distribution CDF (BETADIST)
entries.summary: Scales the source to 0 to 1 within its recent range and reads that position through the cumulative Beta distribution, giving a shaped 0 to 1 oscillator.

entries.title: Bias (BIAS)
entries.summary: The distance of price from its own simple moving average, expressed as a fraction of that average, so stretched moves stand out.

entries.title: Bilateral Filter (BILATERAL)
entries.summary: An edge-preserving smoother that weights each recent bar by how far back it is and how close its price is to the current one.

entries.title: Binomial Distribution CDF (BINOMDIST)
entries.summary: Treats the source's position in its recent range as a success rate p and plots the probability of at most k successes in n trials.

entries.title: Blackman Moving Average (BLMA)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by the Blackman window, a three-term cosine taper that falls to zero at both ends of the lookback.

entries.title: Balance of Power (BOP)
entries.summary: Measures where each bar closed relative to its open, as a share of its range, and smooths it with a warmup-corrected exponential average.

entries.title: Bandpass Filter (BPF)
entries.summary: Runs price through a two-pole highpass and a two-pole lowpass, then plots the price with the band that survives both stages taken out.

entries.title: Bull-Bear Power Ratio (BRAR)
entries.summary: Two sentiment ratios scaled to 100: BR weighs each bar's reach above and below the previous close, AR the same against the bar's own open.

entries.title: Butterworth 2nd Order Filter (BUTTER)
entries.summary: A two-pole recursive lowpass with a maximally flat passband that smooths away price swings shorter than the length.

entries.title: Ehlers 2-Pole Butterworth Filter (BUTTER2)
entries.summary: A second order Butterworth lowpass that smooths price with a maximally flat passband, damping cycles shorter than the length.

entries.title: Ehlers 3-Pole Butterworth Filter (BUTTER3)
entries.summary: A third-order Butterworth lowpass filter on price that removes swings shorter than the chosen period with a steep roll-off and a flat passband.

entries.title: Bessel-Weighted Moving Average (BWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average whose weights follow a Bessel-style window, zero at both ends and heaviest in the middle, with an adjustable taper.

entries.title: Commodity Channel Index (CCI)
entries.summary: How far the typical price sits from its own average, in units of mean absolute deviation, so readings beyond plus or minus 100 mark stretched moves.

entries.title: Ehlers Correlation Cycle (CCOR)
entries.summary: Correlates the last Period prices with one cycle of a cosine and of a negative sine, drawn as two lines scaled to -100 and +100.

entries.title: Close-to-Close Volatility (CCV)
entries.summary: Annualised dispersion of the log returns from one close to the next over a window, ignoring the intrabar range entirely.

entries.title: Ehlers Cyber Cycle (CCYC)
entries.summary: A two-pole high-pass filter over a lightly smoothed price that strips out the trend and leaves the dominant cycle, with a one-bar trigger line.

entries.title: Composite Fractal Behavior (CFB)
entries.summary: Scores how cleanly price has moved over a ladder of lookbacks and blends the ladder into one length in bars, smoothed twice by an adaptive average.

entries.title: Christiano-Fitzgerald Band-Pass Filter (CFITZ)
entries.summary: An asymmetric band-pass filter on the close that weights past bars so the weights sum to zero, giving a cycle line that swings around zero.

entries.title: Chande Forecast Oscillator
entries.summary: The percentage gap between price and the value a straight-line fit over the last N bars forecasts for the current bar.

entries.title: Center of Gravity (CG)
entries.summary: Where the weighted balance point of the last N prices sits relative to the middle of the window, an oscillator that turns at cycle highs and lows.

entries.title: Percentage Change (CHANGE)
entries.summary: Plots the fractional change of the source over a set number of bars, so an unchanged series reads zero and a doubling reads one.

entries.title: Chebyshev Type I Filter (CHEBY1)
entries.summary: A second order Chebyshev Type I lowpass that trades a controlled bump near the cutoff period for a steeper cut of faster price swings.

entries.title: Chebyshev Type II Filter (CHEBY2)
entries.summary: A second order recursive lowpass with zeros placed among fast swings, rescaled so a flat price passes unchanged; the attenuation setting shapes how it treats the fastest noise.

entries.title: Choppiness Index
entries.summary: A 0 to 100 reading of whether recent bars trended or chopped, comparing the summed true range with the window's overall high to low range.

entries.title: Cumulative Moving Average
entries.summary: The running average of every price on the chart so far, from the first bar to the current one, with no lookback window at all.

entries.title: Chaikin Money Flow (CMF)
entries.summary: The share of recent volume that traded on the buying side, from money flow volume summed over a window and divided by total volume.

entries.title: Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO)
entries.summary: Compares the sum of up moves with the sum of down moves over the window and scales the difference from -100 to +100.

entries.title: Cointegration (COINTEGRATION)
entries.summary: A rolling unit-root test statistic on the spread between two price series, showing whether that spread has tended to pull back toward its mean.

entries.title: Convolution Moving Average (CONV)
entries.summary: Weights the last few prices by a kernel of numbers you type in, so any smoother or filter can be written as a list of weights.

entries.title: Coppock Curve (COPPOCK)
entries.summary: A weighted average of two rates of change added together, a slow momentum line that tends to turn up after a decline runs out.

entries.title: Coral Filter (CORAL)
entries.summary: Six chained exponential smoothings recombined with polynomial weights into a smooth trend line that lags less than a plain average.

entries.title: Pearson's Correlation (CORRELATION)
entries.summary: The Pearson correlation between two series of the chart's symbol over a rolling window, from -1 for opposite moves to +1 for moves in step.

entries.title: Covariance (COVARIANCE)
entries.summary: The rolling population covariance of two price series over a window, showing whether they have moved together, apart or independently.

entries.title: Cubic Regression Moving Average (CRMA)
entries.summary: Fits a cubic curve to the lookback window by least squares and plots the fitted value at the newest bar.

entries.title: Connors RSI (CRSI)
entries.summary: A 0 to 100 oscillator that averages a short price RSI, an RSI of the up or down streak, and the percent rank of the one-bar change.

entries.title: Correlation Trend Indicator (CTI)
entries.summary: How closely the last N prices line up with a straight rising line, from -1 for a clean decline to +1 for a clean advance.

entries.title: Cumulative Mean (CUMMEAN)
entries.summary: The running average of a price series over every bar from the start of the chart, a slow baseline that steadies as history grows.

entries.title: Conditional Volatility (CV)
entries.summary: A GARCH(1,1) volatility estimate that blends a long run level, the latest squared return and the previous variance, shown annualised in percent.

entries.title: Chaikin's Volatility (CVI)
entries.summary: The percentage change of a smoothed high-low range over a set number of bars, showing whether bar ranges are widening or narrowing.

entries.title: Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT)
entries.summary: Convolves the source with a Morlet wavelet at one scale and plots the size of the response, showing how strongly that cycle length is present.

entries.title: Donchian Channels (DCHANNEL)
entries.summary: The highest high and lowest low of the last period bars, with the midpoint between them, drawn from the first bar.

entries.title: Decay Min-Max Channel (DECAYCHANNEL)
entries.summary: A high and low channel whose edges are pulled toward the middle harder the longer they go without a new extreme.

entries.title: Ehlers Decycler Oscillator (DECO)
entries.summary: The difference between two high-pass filters, so only the price cycles between a short and a long cutoff period remain.

entries.title: Ehlers Decycler (DECYCLER)
entries.summary: Removes the cycles shorter than a cutoff period from price, leaving a trend line with very little lag.

entries.title: DeMarker Oscillator (DEM)
entries.summary: A 0 to 1 oscillator comparing how far highs pushed above the previous high with how far lows pushed below the previous low.

entries.title: Double Exponential Moving Average (DEMA)
entries.summary: Two chained exponential averages combined as twice the first minus the second, which removes much of the lag of a single EMA.

entries.title: Dirty Data Injection (DIRTY)
entries.summary: Echoes a price series with regular gaps cut into it, so you can see how other studies cope with missing bars.

entries.title: Jurik Directional Movement Index (DMX)
entries.summary: The normalised difference between plus and minus directional movement, smoothed by an adaptive average, from -1 to +1.

entries.title: Derivative Oscillator (DOSC)
entries.summary: A double-smoothed RSI minus its own moving average, a momentum line that crosses zero as the smoothed RSI moves through its average.

entries.title: Detrended Price Oscillator (DPO)
entries.summary: Price minus a simple moving average taken from about half a period earlier, so the trend drops out and shorter cycles stand out.

entries.title: Deviation-Scaled Moving Average (DSMA)
entries.summary: An adaptive average that speeds up when its tracking error is large against its recent size and slows down when it is small.

entries.title: Detrended Synthetic Price (DSP)
entries.summary: The gap between a quarter-cycle and a half-cycle exponential average, which strips out the trend and leaves the dominant cycle swinging around zero.

entries.title: Double Weighted Moving Average (DWMA)
entries.summary: A linearly weighted moving average applied twice over the same period, smoother than one pass while still leaning on recent bars.

entries.title: Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT)
entries.summary: An a trous Haar wavelet decomposition that plots either the smooth trend at the deepest level or the detail removed at one chosen level.

entries.title: Directional Movement Index (DX)
entries.summary: Plots DX, the gap between +DI and -DI as a share of their sum, beside both directional lines, to show how one-sided the movement is.

entries.title: Dynamic Momentum Index (DYMOI)
entries.summary: An RSI whose lookback shortens when recent volatility rises and lengthens when it falls, kept between a minimum and a maximum period.

entries.title: EACP: Ehlers Autocorrelation Periodogram
entries.summary: The dominant cycle length found by autocorrelating filtered price at every lag and taking the centre of gravity of the resulting power spectrum.

entries.title: Ehlers Even Better Sinewave (EBSW)
entries.summary: A detrended, smoothed price cycle normalised by its own recent power into a wave that runs between -1 and +1.

entries.title: EDCF: Ehlers Distance Coefficient Filter
entries.summary: A weighted average whose weights are each bar's summed squared distance from the bars before it, so it turns quickly on sharp moves.

entries.title: Elder's Force Index (EFI)
entries.summary: Multiplies each bar's change in close by its volume and smooths the result, sizing the force behind every move in one line.

entries.title: Elliptic 2nd Order Filter (ELLIPTIC)
entries.summary: A two-pole, two-zero elliptic lowpass on price with a notch just past the cutoff, removing fast noise sharply for a second-order filter.

entries.title: Exponential Moving Average (EMA)
entries.summary: An exponential average with a warmup correction, so it is accurate from the first bar rather than crawling up from a zero start.

entries.title: Entropy (ENTROPY)
entries.summary: Normalised Shannon entropy of the recent window, from 0 when the values crowd into one slice of the range to 1 when they spread evenly.

entries.title: Ease of Movement (EOM)
entries.summary: Measures how far the midpoint of each bar travelled per unit of volume, averaged over a window, so easy moves on light volume read high.

entries.title: Endpoint Moving Average (EPMA)
entries.summary: A linearly weighted average whose weights fall from the newest bar to the oldest, plotted from the first bar.

entries.title: Efficiency Ratio (ER)
entries.summary: The net price move over N bars divided by the sum of every bar-to-bar move, from 0 for pure chop to 1 for a straight trend.

entries.title: Elder Ray Index (ERI)
entries.summary: Bull Power and Bear Power: how far each bar's high and low reached away from an exponential average of the close.

entries.title: Elder's Thermometer (ETHERM)
entries.summary: Measures how far each bar reaches beyond the previous bar's high or low, with an exponential signal line and a colour for hot and explosive bars.

entries.title: Elastic Volume Weighted Moving Average (EVWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average that steps toward price by each bar's share of recent volume, so heavy bars move it far and quiet bars barely move it.

entries.title: Exponential Weighted MA Volatility
entries.summary: Volatility from an exponentially weighted average of squared log returns, corrected for start-up bias and optionally annualised.

entries.title: Exponential Transformation (EXP)
entries.summary: Applies y = e^x to the source bar by bar, a numeric transform meant for series already scaled near zero, such as a log return.

entries.title: Exponential Distribution CDF (EXPDIST)
entries.summary: Scales the source to 0 to 1 within its recent range and reads that position through an exponential distribution, so it rises quickly off the lows.

entries.title: Exponential Transformation (EXP)
entries.summary: Applies y = e^x to the source bar by bar, a numeric transform meant for series already scaled near zero, such as a log return.

entries.title: Fractal Chaos Bands (FCB)
entries.summary: Bands at the highest recent three-bar fractal high and the lowest recent fractal low, with optional marks on the fractal bars.

entries.title: F-Distribution CDF (FDIST)
entries.summary: Scales the source to 0 to 1 within its recent range and reads that position through the cumulative F distribution, a bounded 0 to 1 oscillator.

entries.title: FFT Dominant Cycle (Radix-2 FFT)
entries.summary: Estimates the length of the strongest price cycle, in bars, from a Hann-windowed fast Fourier transform of the last N bars.

entries.title: Force Index (FI)
entries.summary: The change in close multiplied by volume and smoothed with an exponential average, showing who won each stretch of bars and with how much weight.

entries.title: Fisher Transform
entries.summary: Places price inside its recent range, smooths it, and stretches it with the inverse hyperbolic tangent so turning points read as sharp peaks.

entries.title: Fisher04 - Ehlers 2004 Cybernetic Analysis
entries.summary: A Fisher transform of the bar midpoint within its recent range, with a signal line that is simply the previous bar's value.

entries.title: Williams Fractals
entries.summary: Marks every five-bar swing high and swing low, the turning points where price stalled and reversed for at least two bars on each side.

entries.title: Fractal Adaptive Moving Average (FRAMA)
entries.summary: An adaptive average whose smoothing follows the fractal dimension of price: fast in a clean trend, nearly still in a choppy range.

entries.title: Fibonacci Weighted Moving Average (FWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by the Fibonacci sequence, so the newest bars dominate and the line hugs price closely.

entries.title: Gamma Distribution CDF (GAMMADIST)
entries.summary: Reads the source's position inside its recent high-low range through the gamma cumulative distribution, giving an oscillator from 0 to 1.

entries.title: Williams Gator Oscillator
entries.summary: Two histograms that show how far apart the three displaced alligator lines have moved: wide bars for a trending market, bars near zero for a quiet one.

entries.title: Gaussian Filter (GAUSS)
entries.summary: A weighted average of recent prices using a bell-shaped Gaussian kernel whose width is set by sigma, answering from the first bar.

entries.title: Generalized Double Exponential Moving Average (GDEMA)
entries.summary: A double exponential average with an adjustable lag correction, from a plain EMA at v = 0 to a line that removes more lag than it adds above v = 1.

entries.title: Geometric Mean (GEOMEAN)
entries.summary: The geometric mean of the last N positive prices: the exponential of their average logarithm, a centre line that compounds rather than adds.

entries.title: Gann High-Low Activator
entries.summary: A trailing line built from short averages of the highs and lows that flips sides when price closes beyond it, with BUY and SELL marks on each flip.

entries.title: Garman-Klass Volatility (GKV)
entries.summary: Volatility estimated from each bar's open, high, low and close, smoothed with a bias-corrected average and optionally annualised.

entries.title: Granger Causality Test (GRANGER)
entries.summary: An F-statistic asking whether the previous value of a second series improves the prediction of the first beyond its own previous value.

entries.title: Gaussian-Weighted Moving Average (GWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average whose weights follow a bell curve centred on the middle of the window, tapering at both ends.

entries.title: HA: Heikin-Ashi
entries.summary: Smoothed candles drawn over the chart: each closes at the bar's average price and opens at the midpoint of the previous smoothed candle.

entries.title: Hamming Moving Average (HAMMA)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by the Hamming window, heaviest in the middle of the lookback and lightest at its two ends.

entries.title: Hanning Moving Average (HANMA)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by a raised cosine window, zero at both ends of the lookback and heaviest in the middle.

entries.title: Hann FIR Filter (HANN)
entries.summary: A finite-window weighted average of price with raised-cosine weights, smoother and less ringing than a flat moving average of the same length.

entries.title: Harmonic Mean (HARMEAN)
entries.summary: The harmonic mean of the last N positive values: the count divided by the sum of their reciprocals, a mean pulled toward the smaller readings.

entries.title: Hull Exponential Moving Average (HEMA)
entries.summary: A low-lag average that combines a fast and a slow exponential average with logarithmic weights and smooths the result once more.

entries.title: Henderson Moving Average (HEND)
entries.summary: A symmetric weighted average with closed-form Henderson weights that pass a cubic trend through without distortion.

entries.title: Highest Value (HIGHEST)
entries.summary: Traces the highest value of the source over a rolling window, starting on the first bar with the highest value seen so far.

entries.title: Midprice (HL2)
entries.summary: Draws the midpoint of every bar's range, half the sum of its high and its low, as a single line over the price.

entries.title: Typical Price (HLC3)
entries.summary: Draws the typical price of each bar, the average of its high, low and close, as one line over the candles.

entries.title: Weighted Close (HLCC4)
entries.summary: Draws the weighted close of each bar, the average of high, low and the close counted twice, as one line over the candles.

entries.title: High-Low Volatility (HLV)
entries.summary: Volatility from the squared log range of each bar, smoothed with a bias-corrected average and optionally annualised.

entries.title: Hull Moving Average (HMA)
entries.summary: Twice a half-period weighted average less a full-period one, smoothed again over the square root of the period.

entries.title: Holt Exponential Moving Average (HOLT)
entries.summary: Double exponential smoothing that tracks a level and a trend and plots their sum, so the line lags less than a plain EMA while a move runs.

entries.title: HOMOD: Homodyne Discriminator Dominant Cycle
entries.summary: The dominant cycle length in bars from a homodyne discriminator on a Hilbert transform of price, held to your period range and smoothed.

entries.title: Hodrick-Prescott Filter (HP)
entries.summary: Splits price into a smooth trend drawn on the chart and a cycle drawn in its own pane, with lambda setting how stiff the trend is.

entries.title: Highpass Filter (2-Pole) (HPF)
entries.summary: Strips out price swings shorter than a chosen cycle length with a two-pole highpass filter and draws the smooth trend that is left behind.

entries.title: HT_DCPERIOD: Hilbert Transform Dominant Cycle Period
entries.summary: The length in bars of the market's dominant cycle, measured by a Hilbert transform of smoothed price, held to 6 to 50 bars and smoothed.

entries.title: HT_DCPHASE: Hilbert Transform Dominant Cycle Phase
entries.summary: Where the market sits inside its dominant cycle, as an angle in radians from -pi to pi, from the Hilbert transform's in-phase and quadrature parts.

entries.title: HT_PHASOR: Hilbert Transform Phasor Components
entries.summary: The in-phase and quadrature components of the dominant cycle from an adaptive Hilbert transform of smoothed price, drawn as two lines.

entries.title: HT_SINE: Hilbert Transform - SineWave
entries.summary: The sine of the dominant cycle's phase, and the sine of that phase plus 45 degrees, from an adaptive Hilbert transform of smoothed price.

entries.title: HT_TRENDMODE: Hilbert Transform Trend Mode
entries.summary: A step line that reads 1 when a Hilbert transform cycle measurement says the market is trending and 0 when it says the market is cycling.

entries.title: Hilbert Trendline (HTIT)
entries.summary: A trendline built from a twice smoothed price plus a small cyclic correction measured with a Hilbert transform.

entries.title: Huber Loss (HUBER)
entries.summary: The average Huber penalty of the gap between price and its own exponential average: squared for small gaps, linear for large ones.

entries.title: Hurst Exponent (HURST)
entries.summary: Rescaled range estimate of the Hurst exponent of recent log returns: above 0.5 reads as trending, below 0.5 as mean reverting.

entries.title: Historical Volatility (HV)
entries.summary: The population standard deviation of log returns over a rolling window, optionally scaled to an annual figure.

entries.title: Holt-Winters Moving Average (HWMA)
entries.summary: Triple exponential smoothing that tracks level, velocity and acceleration, so the line keeps moving through a turn instead of flattening.

entries.title: Ichimoku Cloud
entries.summary: Five lines built from range midpoints, with a shaded cloud projected ahead of price that marks trend, support and resistance at a glance.

entries.title: Inverse Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT)
entries.summary: Rebuilds price from only the slowest frequency components of a Hann-windowed transform, a smooth line that ignores fast swings.

entries.title: Intraday Intensity Index (III)
entries.summary: Signs each bar's volume by where the close sits in the bar's range, then averages it over a window or adds it into a running total.

entries.title: Integral of Linear Regression Slope (ILRS)
entries.summary: Adds up the rolling least squares slope bar by bar, giving a price follower built from the speed of the trend.

entries.title: Intraday Momentum Index (IMI)
entries.summary: An oscillator from 0 to 100 built from candle bodies: the share of the period's body size that came from bars closing above their open.

entries.title: Inertia
entries.summary: The distance between the source and the end of a least-squares line fitted through its recent values, positive when price runs ahead of its trend.

entries.title: Interquartile Range (IQR)
entries.summary: The distance between the 75th and the 25th percentile of the last N values, a measure of spread that ignores the extremes.

entries.title: Jarque-Bera Test (JB)
entries.summary: A statistic that tests whether the last N values look normally distributed, built from their skewness and excess kurtosis.

entries.title: Jurik Volatility Bands (JBANDS)
entries.summary: Upper and lower bands that snap to a bar's extreme when price pushes through and otherwise fall back at a rate set by relative volatility.

entries.title: Acceleration, Slope of Slope (JERK)
entries.summary: Three chained rolling regressions, slope then acceleration then jerk, showing how quickly a trend's acceleration is itself changing.

entries.title: Jurik Moving Average (JMA)
entries.summary: An adaptive average that smooths harder in quiet markets and follows faster in volatile ones, with a phase control for lag versus overshoot.

entries.title: Acceleration, Slope of Slope (JOLT)
entries.summary: The slope of acceleration from three nested rolling least squares fits, measuring how fast a trend's curvature is changing.

entries.title: Jurik Volatility (JVOLTY)
entries.summary: The adaptive volatility ratio of an adaptive moving average, shown on its own: current movement over its smoothed average, floored at 1.

entries.title: Normalized Jurik Volatility (JVOLTYN)
entries.summary: The adaptive volatility ratio passed through a logistic curve, so it reads 0.5 at normal pace and climbs towards 1 as movement grows.

entries.title: Kaiser Window Moving Average (KAISER)
entries.summary: A symmetric moving average weighted by the Kaiser window, with a beta setting that shapes how fast the weights taper.

entries.title: Kalman Filter (KALMAN)
entries.summary: Smooths price with a one-dimensional Kalman filter, where process noise and measurement noise decide how much each new bar moves the line.

entries.title: Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average (KAMA)
entries.summary: An average whose speed follows the efficiency ratio: it tracks a clean trend closely and flattens out when price chops back and forth.

entries.title: Keltner Channel (KCHANNEL)
entries.summary: An exponential average of the source with bands a multiple of the average true range above and below, drawn from the first bar.

entries.title: KDJ
entries.summary: A stochastic oscillator with three lines: K smooths the raw stochastic, D smooths K, and J leads both by extrapolating their gap.

entries.title: Kendall Rank Correlation (KENDALL)
entries.summary: Kendall's tau between two series over the last N bars: +1 when they always move the same way, -1 when they always move apart.

entries.title: Kalman Filter (KF)
entries.summary: Treats price as a noisy reading of a hidden level and tracks that level, with the balance of process noise and measurement noise setting its speed.

entries.title: Kairi Relative Index (KRI)
entries.summary: The percentage distance of price from its own simple moving average, so zero is the average and the extremes show how stretched price has become.

entries.title: KST Oscillator (KST)
entries.summary: Four rates of change over increasing lookbacks, each smoothed and summed with weights 1 to 4, plus a smoothed signal line.

entries.title: Kurtosis, tailedness (KURTOSIS)
entries.summary: Excess kurtosis of the last N values: above zero when the window has fatter tails and a sharper peak than a normal distribution.

entries.title: Klinger Volume Oscillator (KVO)
entries.summary: The gap between a fast and a slow exponential mean of trend-signed volume force, with a signal line and a coloured histogram.

entries.title: Ehlers Laguerre Filter (LAGUERRE)
entries.summary: A four-stage Laguerre smoother on price with one damping setting, giving a smooth trend line from very few bars of history.

entries.title: Lanczos (Sinc) Window Moving Average (LANCZOS)
entries.summary: A symmetric moving average weighted by one lobe of the sinc function, peaking at the centre of the window.

entries.title: Leader EMA (LEMA)
entries.summary: An exponential average plus a smoothed copy of its own tracking error, so it leans ahead of a plain EMA of the same period.

entries.title: Linear Transformation (LINEAR)
entries.summary: Rescales the source around its own moving average with a scale and an offset, stretching or damping every excursion from the mean.

entries.title: Linear Transformation (LINEAR)
entries.summary: Applies y = a * (x - SMA) + SMA + b to the source, so the scale reshapes swings around the average and the offset shifts the line.

entries.title: Linear Regression (LINREG)
entries.summary: The end point of a least squares line fitted through the last N values, the price the recent trend says this bar should have.

entries.title: Least Mean Squares Adaptive Filter (LMS)
entries.summary: An adaptive filter that predicts each bar from the bars before it and keeps adjusting its own weights toward whatever would have been right.

entries.title: LOESS Filter
entries.summary: Fits a tricube-weighted straight line through a short window of recent prices and draws the value of that line at the centre of the window.

entries.title: Logarithmic Transformation (LOG)
entries.summary: Plots the natural logarithm of the source in its own pane, so equal percentage moves take up equal vertical distance.

entries.title: Log-Cosh Loss
entries.summary: A rolling average of log(cosh(actual minus predicted)), an error measure that acts squared for small misses and linear for large ones.

entries.title: Log-Normal Distribution CDF (LOGNORMDIST)
entries.summary: Reads the source's position inside its recent high-low range off a log-normal cumulative curve, an oscillator bounded between 0 and 1.

entries.title: Logarithmic Transformation (LOG)
entries.summary: Turns the source into its natural logarithm, compressing a multiplicative price scale into an additive one in a separate pane.

entries.title: Lowest Value (LOWEST)
entries.summary: Traces the lowest value of the source over a rolling window, starting on the first bar with the lowest value seen so far.

entries.title: LRSI: Laguerre RSI
entries.summary: An RSI built from four cascaded Laguerre filter stages instead of a lookback window, reading 0 to 1 and turning within a couple of bars.

entries.title: Least Squares Moving Average (LSMA)
entries.summary: Fits a least squares straight line to the last N prices and plots its value at the current bar.

entries.title: Linear Time Moving Average (LTMA)
entries.summary: A linearly weighted average over the period: the newest bar counts the full period, the oldest counts one, and older bars fade out evenly.

entries.title: Lunar Phase (LUNAR)
entries.summary: The illuminated fraction of the moon at each bar's opening time, from 0 at new moon to 1 at full moon, with markers at the four main phases.

entries.title: Mean Arctangent Absolute Percentage Error
entries.summary: A rolling average of the arctangent of the absolute percentage error between two series, bounded between zero and pi/2.

entries.title: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD)
entries.summary: The gap between a fast and a slow exponential average, a smoothed signal line of that gap, and their difference as a coloured histogram.

entries.title: Mean Absolute Error (MAE)
entries.summary: The average absolute distance between price and its own EMA over a rolling window, read as the typical error of that average.

entries.title: MA Envelope (MAE)
entries.summary: A moving average with two bands set a fixed percentage above and below it, so the channel scales with price rather than with volatility.

entries.title: MESA Adaptive Moving Average (MAMA)
entries.summary: Two adaptive averages whose smoothing is set by how far the measured cycle phase steps each bar; FAMA follows MAMA at half the rate.

entries.title: Mean Absolute %Deviation (MAPD)
entries.summary: The average distance between price and its own EMA, as a percentage of the EMA, over a rolling window of bars.

entries.title: Mean Absolute %Error (MAPE)
entries.summary: The average absolute gap between price and its own EMA, as a percentage of price, over a rolling window of bars.

entries.title: MARKETFI: Market Facilitation Index
entries.summary: The bar's high-to-low range divided by its volume: how much price movement each traded unit bought on that bar.

entries.title: Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE)
entries.summary: The average absolute gap between price and its own EMA, divided by a naive-forecast scale, over a rolling window of bars.

entries.title: Mass Index (MASSI)
entries.summary: Sums the ratio of a single to a double exponential average of the bar range, so a widening range shows as a bulge in the line.

entries.title: Moving Average Variable Period (MAVP)
entries.summary: An exponential average whose period is clamped between a floor and a ceiling, with a warmup correction so it draws from the first bar.

entries.title: MCNMA - McNicholl EMA
entries.summary: A low-lag average: twice a triple exponential average minus the triple exponential average of it, built from six cascaded stages.

entries.title: Median Absolute Error
entries.summary: The rolling median of the absolute gap between an actual series and a predicted one, a typical error that ignores outliers.

entries.title: Median Absolute Percentage Error
entries.summary: The rolling median of the percentage gap between an actual series and a predicted one, a forecast error score that one outlier bar barely moves.

entries.title: Mean Error (ME)
entries.summary: The average signed gap between price and its own EMA over a rolling window, showing whether price has been sitting above or below it.

entries.title: Mean Deviation (MEANDEV)
entries.summary: The average absolute distance of the last N values from their own mean, a measure of spread that does not square the outliers.

entries.title: Median
entries.summary: The middle value of the source over a rolling window, a centre line that a single outlier bar cannot drag around the way it drags a mean.

entries.title: MEDPRICE: Median Price
entries.summary: The midpoint of each bar's range, halfway between its high and its low, drawn on the price chart with no smoothing.

entries.title: Money Flow Index (MFI)
entries.summary: A volume-weighted strength oscillator from 0 to 100 that compares money flowing in on rising bars with money flowing out on falling bars.

entries.title: McGinley Dynamic Indicator (MGDI)
entries.summary: An adaptive average whose step toward price is divided by the fourth power of the price to line ratio, so it follows falls faster than rallies.

entries.title: Midpoint (MIDPOINT)
entries.summary: The centre of the source's rolling range: the average of its highest and lowest value over the lookback window.

entries.title: MIDPRICE: Midpoint Price over Period
entries.summary: The centre of the recent trading range: the highest high and the lowest low of the last N bars, averaged into one line.

entries.title: Multilayer Perceptron Predictor
entries.summary: A small neural network trained bar by bar on six price features, drawing its five-bar price prediction back on the bar it was made from.

entries.title: Modified Moving Average (MMA)
entries.summary: A simple moving average plus a linear end-point correction from the same window, which removes most of the lag of the plain mean.

entries.title: Min-Max Channel (MMCHANNEL)
entries.summary: The highest high and the lowest low of the lookback window drawn as a channel, marking the levels a breakout has to clear.

entries.title: Mode
entries.summary: The value that repeats most often in the recent window, drawn only when some value actually repeats, marking prices the market keeps returning to.

entries.title: Modular Filter (MODF)
entries.summary: Blends two exponential bands, one that snaps up to price and one that snaps down, into a filter that ranges from smooth average to trailing stop.

entries.title: Momentum (MOM)
entries.summary: The plain price difference between this bar and the bar a fixed number of bars back, drawn as a line around zero.

entries.title: Mean %Error (MPE)
entries.summary: The average signed percentage by which price sits above or below its own EMA, over a rolling window of bars.

entries.title: Mean Relative Absolute Error
entries.summary: A rolling average of the absolute gap between two series as a fraction of the actual value, where 0 is a perfect match.

entries.title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
entries.summary: The average squared gap between price and its own EMA over a rolling window, a measure that weighs large misses heavily.

entries.title: Mean Squared Logarithmic Error (MSLE)
entries.summary: The average squared gap between log(1 + price) and log(1 + its EMA) over a rolling window, a scale-free error measure.

entries.title: Ehlers MESA Stochastic (MSTOCH)
entries.summary: A stochastic taken on filtered price, with trend and noise removed first, then smoothed into an oscillator between 0 and 1.

entries.title: Normalized Average True Range
entries.summary: The average true range expressed as a percentage of the close, so volatility compares across instruments and price levels.

entries.title: Non-Lag Moving Average (NLMA)
entries.summary: A long weighted average whose cosine kernel adds negative weights to older bars, cutting lag while still smoothing short noise.

entries.title: NMA - Natural Moving Average
entries.summary: An adaptive average whose speed is set by where in the window the movement of log price happened: recent movement makes it fast.

entries.title: Min-Max Normalization (NORMALIZE)
entries.summary: Rescales the source to a 0 to 1 range by its own lowest and highest readings over a lookback window.

entries.title: Normal Distribution CDF (NORMDIST)
entries.summary: Turns the source's z-score over a rolling window into a normal cumulative probability, read as a percentile from 0 to 1.

entries.title: Notch Filter (NOTCH)
entries.summary: Removes one chosen cycle length from price with a second-order notch filter and leaves the rest of the movement close to untouched.

entries.title: Negative Volume Index (NVI)
entries.summary: A cumulative index starting at 100 that follows the price change only on bars whose volume fell against the bar before.

entries.title: NW - Nadaraya-Watson Kernel Regression
entries.summary: A backward-looking kernel regression: each bar is a Gaussian weighted average of recent prices, with the bandwidth setting how fast older bars fade.

entries.title: Nyquist Moving Average (NYQMA)
entries.summary: A weighted average pushed forward by its distance from a second, smoother average of itself, which takes back most of its lag.

entries.title: On Balance Volume (OBV)
entries.summary: A running total that adds each bar's volume on a higher close and subtracts it on a lower close, tracking where volume is flowing.

entries.title: Open-Close Midpoint (OC2)
entries.summary: Draws the centre of every candle body, half the sum of its open and its close, ignoring the wicks entirely.

entries.title: Open-High-Low Average (OHL3)
entries.summary: Draws the average of each bar's open, high and low, a reference price that leaves out where the bar closed.

entries.title: OHLC Average (OHLC4)
entries.summary: Draws the mean of each bar's open, high, low and close, one quieter representative price for the whole bar.

entries.title: One Euro Filter (ONEEURO)
entries.summary: An adaptive smoother that filters heavily while price is quiet and lifts its cutoff when price moves fast, trading jitter against lag.

entries.title: Parzen Window Moving Average (PARZEN)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by a smooth piecewise cubic bell that falls to zero at both ends of the window, for a quiet line with little ripple.

entries.title: Price Channel (PCHANNEL)
entries.summary: The highest high and lowest low of the lookback window with their midpoint, showing the extremes a new move has to break.

entries.title: Percentile
entries.summary: The value at a chosen percentile of the source over a rolling window, drawn on the price chart, interpolated between the two nearest ranks.

entries.title: PFE: Polarized Fractal Efficiency
entries.summary: How directly price travelled over a lookback, from -100 to +100: the straight-line distance over the path actually walked, signed by direction.

entries.title: Pretty Good Oscillator
entries.summary: How far price sits from its simple average, measured in units of average true range, so a reading beyond plus or minus 3 marks a stretched move.

entries.title: Ehlers Phasor Analysis (PHASOR)
entries.summary: The phase angle of price against a reference cosine and sine of one Period, unwrapped and ratcheted, with an optional derived cycle period and trend state.

entries.title: Pivot Points (Classic)
entries.summary: The classic floor pivot: the previous day, week or month's high, low and close turned into a central pivot with three supports and three resistances.

entries.title: Pivot Points (Camarilla)
entries.summary: Four supports and four resistances placed tightly around the previous period's close, each a fixed fraction of that period's range away from it.

entries.title: Pivot Points (DeMark)
entries.summary: A pivot, one resistance and one support from the previous period, weighted by whether that period closed above, below or at its open.

entries.title: Pivot Points (Extended)
entries.summary: The classic floor pivot carried out to five resistance and five support levels, built from the previous day, week or month's high, low and close.

entries.title: Pivot Points (Fibonacci)
entries.summary: Three supports and three resistances placed 38.2, 61.8 and 100 percent of the previous period's range away from the classic pivot.

entries.title: Pivot Points (Woodie)
entries.summary: A pivot that weights the previous close twice, with three supports and three resistances built from the previous day, week or month.

entries.title: Ehlers Predictive Moving Average (PMA)
entries.summary: A weighted average with one lag cancelled by extrapolation, plus a faster trigger line that leads it.

entries.title: Price Momentum Oscillator (PMO)
entries.summary: A percentage rate of change smoothed twice by exponential averages, with a third average as its signal line.

entries.title: Poisson Distribution CDF (POISSONDIST)
entries.summary: Reads price's position in its recent range as a Poisson event rate and plots the chance of at most k events at that rate.

entries.title: Polynomial Fitting (POLYFIT)
entries.summary: Fits a least-squares polynomial of the chosen degree to the recent window and plots the fitted curve's value at the current bar.

entries.title: Percentage Price Oscillator (PPO)
entries.summary: The gap between a fast and a slow exponential average as a percentage of the slow one, with a signal line and a histogram.

entries.title: Parabolic SAR
entries.summary: A trailing stop and reverse line that accelerates toward price as a trend makes new extremes, and flips to the other side when price trades through it.

entries.title: Pseudo-Huber Loss
entries.summary: A rolling average of the smooth Huber loss between an actual and a predicted series, quadratic for small misses and close to linear for large ones.

entries.title: Psychological Line (PSL)
entries.summary: The percentage of up bars among the last N bars, a simple count of how one-sided recent trading has been, from 0 to 100.

entries.title: Parkinson Volatility (PV)
entries.summary: Volatility from the squared log ratio of each bar's high to its low, smoothed over a window and optionally annualised.

entries.title: Price Volume Divergence (PVD)
entries.summary: Compares the direction of price change with the direction of volume change and sizes the disagreement, positive when they diverge.

entries.title: Positive Volume Index (PVI)
entries.summary: A cumulative index starting at 100 that follows the price change only on bars whose volume rose against the bar before.

entries.title: Percentage Volume Oscillator (PVO)
entries.summary: The gap between a fast and a slow exponential mean of volume as a percentage of the slow one, with a signal line and a histogram.

entries.title: Price Volume Rank (PVR)
entries.summary: Classifies every bar from 0 to 4 by whether price and volume rose or fell together against the bar before.

entries.title: Price Volume Trend (PVT)
entries.summary: A running total of volume weighted by each bar's percentage price change, drawn with a moving average signal line and shaded by which of the two leads.

entries.title: Pascal Weighted Moving Average (PWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average weighted by a row of Pascal's triangle, a bell of binomial weights that puts most of the weight on the middle of the window.

entries.title: Quadruple EMA (QEMA)
entries.summary: Four chained exponential stages with rising smoothing factors, combined 4, -6, 4, -1 to cancel most of the lag of an ordinary EMA.

entries.title: Quantitative Qualitative Estimation (QQE)
entries.summary: A smoothed RSI with a trailing band set by the RSI's own volatility; when the line crosses the trailing level, momentum has shifted.

entries.title: Quadratic Regression Moving Average (QRMA)
entries.summary: Fits a parabola to the last N prices by least squares and plots the fitted value at the newest bar, so the line follows curvature as well as slope.

entries.title: Qstick Indicator
entries.summary: A moving average of the candle body, close minus open, that reads whether bars have been closing above or below where they opened.

entries.title: Quantile (QUANTILE)
entries.summary: The requested quantile of the source over a rolling window, drawn on the price chart: 0.5 is the rolling median, 0 the low, 1 the high.

entries.title: Quantile Loss (Pinball Loss)
entries.summary: A rolling average of the pinball loss, an error score that charges misses above and below the forecast at different rates set by a quantile.

entries.title: Relative Absolute Error (RAE)
entries.summary: Absolute error of an exponential average as a forecast, divided by the absolute error of a plain rolling mean: below 1 the average does better.

entries.title: Rainbow Moving Average (RAIN)
entries.summary: Ten simple averages stacked on top of each other and blended back into one line, with the faster layers weighted most.

entries.title: RAVI: Chande Range Action Verification Index
entries.summary: The percentage gap between a fast and a slow simple average of the close, read against a threshold to separate trends from ranges.

entries.title: Ehlers Reflex Indicator (REFLEX)
entries.summary: A zero-centred cycle oscillator that measures how far a smoothed price bends away from a straight line drawn across one period.

entries.title: Regression Channels (REGCHANNEL)
entries.summary: A least-squares trend line through the last N prices, with bands set a multiple of the fit's own residual spread above and below it.

entries.title: Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU)
entries.summary: Splits the gap between price and its 20-bar average into an upper line for strength and a mirrored lower line for weakness.

entries.title: Regularized EMA (REMA)
entries.summary: An exponential average blended with a regularization term by a lambda setting, which in this form slows the step by alpha times lambda.

entries.title: Ehlers Reverse EMA (REVERSEEMA)
entries.summary: An exponential average minus its own reversed-filter estimate, leaving a zero-centred oscillator that keeps the smoothing but sheds the lag.

entries.title: Recursive Gaussian Moving Average (RGMA)
entries.summary: A cascade of identical exponential stages that approximates a Gaussian filter, giving a very smooth line with an even response.

entries.title: Recursive Least Squares Adaptive Filter (RLS)
entries.summary: An adaptive filter that re-estimates its weights every bar by recursive least squares, with a forgetting factor setting how much history still counts.

entries.title: Wilder's Moving Average (RMA)
entries.summary: A slow exponential average with a smoothing factor of one over the period, corrected during warmup so it draws from the first bar.

entries.title: Ehlers Recursive Median Filter (RMED)
entries.summary: An exponential smoothing of the five-bar median price, which ignores one-bar spikes that would jolt an ordinary moving average.

entries.title: Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE)
entries.summary: The typical distance between price and its own exponential average over a rolling window, in price units, with the average drawn on the chart.

entries.title: Root Mean Squared Logarithmic Error (RMSLE)
entries.summary: The typical log distance between price and its own exponential average over a rolling window, a relative gap that does not depend on price level.

entries.title: Rate of Change (ROC)
entries.summary: The source now minus the source a number of bars back, in price units, with a lookback that grows from the first bar up to the length.

entries.title: Rate of Change Percentage (ROCP)
entries.summary: The percentage change between the source now and the source a number of bars back, with a lookback that grows from the first bar.

entries.title: Rate of Change Ratio (ROCR)
entries.summary: The ratio of the source now to the source a number of bars back, so 1 is unchanged, above 1 is a rise and below 1 a fall.

entries.title: Ehlers Roofing Filter (ROOFING)
entries.summary: A highpass and a Super Smoother in series that keep only the price cycles between two lengths, plotted as a zero-centred oscillator.

entries.title: Relative Squared Error (RSE)
entries.summary: Squared error of an exponential average as a forecast, divided by the squared error of a plain rolling mean: below 1 the average does better.

entries.title: Relative Strength Index (RSI)
entries.summary: Average up move against average down move over the lookback, mapped onto a scale from 0 to 100.

entries.title: R² Coefficient of Determination (RSQUARED)
entries.summary: How much of price's variation around its rolling mean an exponential average explains: 1 is a perfect fit and below 0 is worse than flat.

entries.title: Rogers-Satchell Volatility (RSV)
entries.summary: A volatility estimate built from each bar's open, high, low and close designed so that a steady trend does not inflate it.

entries.title: Relative Strength Xtra (RSX)
entries.summary: An RSI-style 0 to 100 oscillator whose up and down moves are smoothed by an adaptive filter, giving a much quieter line.

entries.title: Realized Volatility (RV)
entries.summary: Volatility measured from the size of close-to-close log returns, smoothed with a simple average and optionally scaled to a yearly figure.

entries.title: Relative Vigor Index (RVGI)
entries.summary: Compares where bars close relative to their open with the size of their range, so it reads the conviction behind a move as a signed ratio.

entries.title: Relative Volatility Index (RVI)
entries.summary: An RSI-style 0 to 100 oscillator built on standard deviation, showing whether volatility is arriving on rising or falling bars.

entries.title: RWMA: Range Weighted Moving Average
entries.summary: A moving average of the close where each bar is weighted by its own high to low range, so wide bars pull the line harder than narrow ones.

entries.title: SAK: Swiss Army Knife Indicator
entries.summary: One second-order recursive filter whose coefficients switch it between nine filters, from smoothers to highpass, bandpass and bandstop.

entries.title: SAM: Smoothed Adaptive Momentum
entries.summary: Momentum over a lookback set by a measured price cycle, then smoothed by a two-pole filter, with a zero line for reference.

entries.title: Standard Deviation Channel (SDCHANNEL)
entries.summary: A least-squares line through the lookback window with a channel a fixed multiple of the residual standard deviation on each side.

entries.title: Savitzky-Golay Filter (SGF)
entries.summary: A smoothing line built from a polynomial fitting kernel, which at the default order keeps the height of a swing better than a plain moving average of the same length.

entries.title: Savitzky-Golay Moving Average (SGMA)
entries.summary: A symmetric weighted average over an odd window: a fixed coefficient table for degree 2 on 5, 7 or 9 bars, and a polynomial weight shape otherwise.

entries.title: Logistic Function (SIGMOID)
entries.summary: Passes the distance between price and its 200-bar average through the logistic curve, giving an oscillator bounded between 0 and 1.

entries.title: Ehlers Sine Wave (SINE)
entries.summary: The phase of the detrended price cycle as a wave between -1 and +1, from the in-phase value over its length with a quadrature partner.

entries.title: Sine-weighted Moving Average (SINEMA)
entries.summary: A moving average whose weights follow half a sine wave across the window, so the middle bars count most and the line runs smooth.

entries.title: Skewness (SKEW)
entries.summary: A rolling measure of how lopsided the recent values are about their mean: positive when the long tail is above, negative when it is below.

entries.title: Slope, Linear Regression (SLOPE)
entries.summary: Plots the slope of the least squares line fitted through the last N values, in price units per bar.

entries.title: Simple Moving Average (SMA)
entries.summary: The plain average of the last N prices, with every bar in the window counted equally, drawn from the very first bar of the chart.

entries.title: Symmetric Mean Absolute %Error (SMAPE)
entries.summary: The average symmetric percentage gap between price and its own exponential average, a bounded error score that treats overshoot and undershoot alike.

entries.title: Stochastic Momentum Index (SMI)
entries.summary: Where the close sits relative to the midpoint of its recent high-low range, double smoothed and centred on zero, with a smoothed signal line.

entries.title: Solar Cycle (SOLAR)
entries.summary: Plots the sine of the Sun's position along the ecliptic at each bar's time, a calendar wave from -1 at the winter solstice to +1 at the summer solstice.

entries.title: SP15: Spencer 15-Point Moving Average
entries.summary: A fixed 15-bar weighted average of the close, with weights chosen so that cycles four and five bars long are removed rather than only damped.

entries.title: Ehlers Super Passband Filter (SPBF)
entries.summary: The difference of two fast exponential smoothings of price, a zero-centred passband line with a root-mean-square envelope above and below.

entries.title: Spearman Rank Correlation (SPEARMAN)
entries.summary: Correlation between the ranks of two series of the chart's symbol over a window: whether they move together in order, regardless of size.

entries.title: Square Root Transformation (SQRT)
entries.summary: Plots the square root of the chosen source, which compresses large values and stretches small ones onto a flatter scale.

entries.title: Square Root Transformation (SQRT)
entries.summary: Plots y equal to the square root of the source, compressing large readings far more than small ones and leaving gaps below zero.

entries.title: Squeeze Momentum (SQUEEZE)
entries.summary: Flags the quiet stretches where the Bollinger Bands sit inside the Keltner Channel, and draws a momentum histogram for the move that follows.

entries.title: Supersmooth Filter (SSF)
entries.summary: A two-pole recursive lowpass filter that removes short-term chop from price with much less lag than a moving average of the same length.

entries.title: Ehlers 2-Pole Super Smoother Filter (SSF2)
entries.summary: A two-pole recursive smoother that removes the fast wiggle a moving average of the same length still passes, with less lag.

entries.title: Ehlers 3-Pole Super Smoother Filter (SSF3)
entries.summary: A three-pole recursive smoother on price that removes short swings with little lag and almost no overshoot, answering from the first bar.

entries.title: SSF-Based Detrended Synthetic Price
entries.summary: Subtracts a half-cycle Super Smoother filter from a quarter-cycle one, leaving a zero-centred oscillator that follows the market's dominant cycle.

entries.title: Standardization (Z-score)
entries.summary: Shows how many sample standard deviations the source sits above or below its own rolling mean, so different series share one scale.

entries.title: Stoller Average Range Channel (STARCHANNEL)
entries.summary: A simple mean of the source as the centre line, with bands a multiple of an average true range above and below it.

entries.title: Super Trend Bands (STBANDS)
entries.summary: Ratcheting upper and lower bands built from the bar midpoint plus and minus a multiple of the average true range, tightening until price breaks them.

entries.title: Schaff Trend Cycle (STC)
entries.summary: A MACD line put through two rounds of stochastic scaling, giving a 0 to 100 trend reading that turns faster than the MACD itself.

entries.title: Standard Deviation (STDDEV)
entries.summary: The population standard deviation of the source over a rolling window, a direct measure of how widely recent values spread around their mean.

entries.title: Standard Error of Regression (STDERR)
entries.summary: How far price scatters around its own least-squares trend line over a rolling window: low when price tracks the line, high when it wanders.

entries.title: Stochastic Oscillator (STOCH)
entries.summary: Places the close inside the high-low range of the last K bars as a 0 to 100 reading, with a simple average of it as the %D line.

entries.title: Stochastic Fast (STOCHF)
entries.summary: The raw stochastic: where the close sits in the high-low range of the last K bars, with a D-bar average of it as the signal line.

entries.title: Stochastic RSI (STOCHRSI)
entries.summary: A stochastic applied to the RSI: where the RSI sits inside its own recent range, smoothed into a %K line and a %D signal line.

entries.title: Rolling Sum
entries.summary: The total of the last N values of the source, kept with error compensation so the running total does not drift over a long history.

entries.title: SuperTrend
entries.summary: A trailing line set a multiple of average true range away from the bar midpoint, which flips sides when the close breaks through it.

entries.title: Swing High/Low Detection
entries.summary: Finds bars whose high or low is the extreme of the bars on both sides and holds the latest swing high and swing low as two horizontal lines.

entries.title: SWMA: Symmetric Weighted Moving Average
entries.summary: A moving average of the close with triangular weights, so the bars in the middle of the window count most and the ends count least.

entries.title: Tillson T3 Moving Average (T3)
entries.summary: Six chained exponential averages blended by a volume factor into a smooth line with much less lag than its smoothing would suggest.

entries.title: Hyperbolic Tangent (TANH)
entries.summary: Squashes the distance between price and its 200-bar average through the hyperbolic tangent, giving an oscillator between -1 and +1.

entries.title: TD Sequential (TD_SEQ)
entries.summary: Counts consecutive closes against the close a few bars back up to 9, then a slower countdown toward 13, to flag a move that may be exhausted.

entries.title: Student's t-Distribution CDF (TDIST)
entries.summary: Maps where price sits in its recent range onto a heavy-tailed probability scale from 0 to 1 using the Student's t cumulative distribution.

entries.title: Triple Exponential Moving Average (TEMA)
entries.summary: Three chained exponential averages combined as 3 x EMA1 - 3 x EMA2 + EMA3, which removes most of the lag of a single EMA.

entries.title: Theil Index (THEIL)
entries.summary: Measures how unevenly the last N values of a positive series are spread, from 0 when they are all equal upward as a few values dominate.

entries.title: Theil's U Statistic (TheilU)
entries.summary: Scores a predicted series against an actual one on a scale from 0 for a perfect match to about 1 for a forecast that adds nothing.

entries.title: True Range
entries.summary: Measures each bar's full movement, the bar's own range widened to include any gap from the previous close.

entries.title: TRAMA: Trend Regularity Adaptive Moving Average
entries.summary: An adaptive average that moves fast while new highs or new lows keep printing and slows to a halt when the range stops expanding.

entries.title: Ehlers Trendflex Indicator (TRENDFLEX)
entries.summary: A trend gauge centred on zero: the average distance of smoothed price from its own recent values, scaled by its running root mean square.

entries.title: TRIM: Trimmed Mean Moving Average
entries.summary: Sorts the last N closes, drops a set percentage from each end and averages the middle, so single spikes cannot drag the line.

entries.title: Triangular Moving Average (TRIMA)
entries.summary: A weighted average whose weights peak in the middle of the window, smoother than a simple average of the same length.

entries.title: TRIX
entries.summary: The one-bar percentage change of a triple exponential moving average, a slow momentum line that crosses zero when the smoothed trend turns.

entries.title: Time Series Forecast
entries.summary: Fits a straight line through recent prices and reads it at the newest bar or a set number of bars beyond it, so the line can run ahead of price.

entries.title: True Strength Index (TSI)
entries.summary: Double-smoothed price change over double-smoothed absolute price change, as a percentage from -100 to 100, with a signal line.

entries.title: TTM Trend
entries.summary: A short exponential average coloured by its slope, wrapped in a band as wide as that slope, with a mark where the slope turns.

entries.title: TTM Scalper Alert
entries.summary: Marks every three-bar pivot: a bar whose high tops both neighbours, or whose low sits under both, as short-term turning points.

entries.title: TTM Trend
entries.summary: A slope-coloured short exponential average with a faint ribbon whose width is the slope as a percentage, and triangles at each turn.

entries.title: TUKEY_W: Tukey (Tapered Cosine) Window MA
entries.summary: An average of the close whose weights are flat through the middle of the window and taper off along a cosine curve at both ends.

entries.title: Tukey's Biweight Loss (TukeyBiweight)
entries.summary: A rolling average of the bisquare loss between an actual and a predicted series, a robust error score that caps the cost of any outlier.

entries.title: Trade Volume Index (TVI)
entries.summary: A running total of volume that adds while price ticks up by more than a minimum move and subtracts while it ticks down, holding direction through smaller moves.

entries.title: Time Weighted Average Price (TWAP)
entries.summary: The plain running average of price since the chosen period began, where every bar counts once regardless of how much traded in it.

entries.title: TYPPRICE: Typical Price
entries.summary: The plain average of each bar's high, low and close, a single price for where the bar traded, drawn on the price chart.

entries.title: Ehlers Ultimate Bands (UBANDS)
entries.summary: A low lag ultrasmooth filter of price with bands set a multiple of the root mean square of the residual away from it.

entries.title: Ultimate Channel (UCHANNEL)
entries.summary: A two-pole ultra smooth filter of price as the centre line, with bands a multiple of a smoothed true range on each side.

entries.title: Ulcer Index (UI)
entries.summary: Measures downside risk as the root mean square of the percentage drawdown from the recent high, ignoring upside moves entirely.

entries.title: Ultimate Oscillator (ULTOSC)
entries.summary: Buying pressure summed against true range over a fast, a medium and a slow window, blended by weight into one reading from 0 to 100.

entries.title: Ultrasmooth Filter (USF)
entries.summary: A two-pole recursive filter fed through a momentum term, giving a very smooth price line that turns with little lag.

entries.title: Volume Accumulation (VA)
entries.summary: A running total of volume signed and scaled by how far each close sits above or below the middle of its own bar.

entries.title: Volatility Adjusted Moving Average (VAMA)
entries.summary: A simple moving average whose length stretches when volatility is calm and shrinks when it expands, using two ATR readings.

entries.title: Variance, Dispersion or Spread (VARIANCE)
entries.summary: The population variance of the source over the lookback, showing how widely price has been spread around its own mean.

entries.title: Velocity (VEL)
entries.summary: The change of price over a lookback, smoothed by an adaptive Jurik-style filter so the momentum reading turns with less lag than raw momentum.

entries.title: Volume Force (VF)
entries.summary: Each bar's price change multiplied by its volume, smoothed with an exponential average corrected so it reads accurately from the first bar.

entries.title: VHF: Vertical Horizontal Filter
entries.summary: The range of the closes over a window divided by the total distance they travelled, high in trends and low in ranges.

entries.title: Variable Index Dynamic Average (VIDYA)
entries.summary: An exponential average that speeds up when short-term volatility rises against longer-term volatility and slows down when it falls.

entries.title: Volume Oscillator (VO)
entries.summary: The percentage gap between a short and a long average of volume, with its own averaged signal line, so volume expansion and contraction read around zero.

entries.title: Vortex Indicator
entries.summary: Two lines, VI+ and VI-, that compare upward and downward bar-to-bar movement against true range to show which side is in control.

entries.title: Ehlers Voss Predictive Filter (VOSS)
entries.summary: A two-pole bandpass around one cycle length, with a feedback predictor line that runs a few bars ahead of it so cycle turns show earlier.

entries.title: Volatility of Volatility (VOV)
entries.summary: The standard deviation of a rolling standard deviation, rising when the market's volatility is itself changing quickly.

entries.title: Volatility Ratio (VR)
entries.summary: This bar's true range divided by an average true range, so values above 1 mark bars wider than the recent norm.

entries.title: Volume Rate of Change (VROC)
entries.summary: How much this bar's volume differs from the volume a fixed number of bars ago, shown as a raw difference or as a percentage.

entries.title: Volume Weighted Accumulation/Distribution (VWAD)
entries.summary: An accumulation/distribution total weighted twice by volume, once by the bar's volume and again by its share of recent volume, so heavy bars dominate.

entries.title: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP)
entries.summary: The average price paid since the chosen period began, each bar weighted by its volume, so it shows where the traded value actually sits.

entries.title: VWAP Bands (VWAPBANDS)
entries.summary: A volume weighted average price that restarts each chosen period, with one and two volume weighted standard deviation bands around it.

entries.title: VWAP with Standard Deviation Bands
entries.summary: A volume weighted average price anchored to a chosen reset period, with bands a number of volume weighted standard deviations away.

entries.title: Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA)
entries.summary: A moving average over a fixed window in which each bar is weighted by its volume, so the bars the market traded most pull the line towards them.

entries.title: Williams Accumulation/Distribution (WAD)
entries.summary: A running total of each bar's move from its true range low on an up close, or from its true range high on a down close, weighted by volume.

entries.title: Wavelet Denoising Filter (WAVELET)
entries.summary: Splits price into a smooth trend and layers of detail, shrinks the small details as noise, and adds the rest back to give a denoised price line.

entries.title: Weighted Average (WAVG)
entries.summary: A linearly weighted moving average kept with running sums, with the newest bar weighted most and a value from the very first bar.

entries.title: WCLPRICE: Weighted Close Price
entries.summary: A single-bar average that counts the close twice, so the close carries half the weight and the high and the low a quarter each.

entries.title: Weibull Distribution CDF (WEIBULLDIST)
entries.summary: Places price within its recent high-low range and reads that position through the Weibull cumulative distribution, giving a value from 0 to 1.

entries.title: Wiener Filter (WIENER)
entries.summary: Blends price toward its own mean in proportion to how much of its recent variance looks like noise, smoothing quiet markets hard and trending ones lightly.

entries.title: Williams %R (WILLR)
entries.summary: Where the close sits inside the highest high and lowest low of the lookback window, on a scale from 0 at the top to -100 at the bottom.

entries.title: WINS: Winsorized Mean Moving Average
entries.summary: Averages the last N closes after pulling each tail in to its boundary value, so outliers lose their pull without shrinking the sample.

entries.title: Weighted Moving Average (WMA)
entries.summary: A linearly weighted average in which the newest bar counts most and each older bar counts one step less.

entries.title: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error
entries.summary: Total absolute forecast error over a rolling window as a percentage of the total absolute actual value, steady where a plain percentage error is not.

entries.title: Weighted Root Mean Squared Error
entries.summary: The root of the weighted mean squared gap between two price series over a rolling window, optionally weighting each bar by its volume.

entries.title: Yang-Zhang Volatility (YZV)
entries.summary: A volatility estimate combining the gap from the previous close, the open-to-close move and the intrabar range of every bar.

entries.title: Yang-Zhang Volatility Adjusted Moving Average (YZVAMA)
entries.summary: A simple average whose length shortens when short-term volatility ranks high and lengthens when it ranks low, so it hugs price in active markets.

entries.title: Zero-Lag Double EMA (ZLDEMA)
entries.summary: A double exponential average fed a de-lagged price, combining two kinds of lag reduction into a fast trend line.

entries.title: Zero-Lag EMA (ZLEMA)
entries.summary: An exponential average of a de-lagged price, the price plus its change over half the period, so it follows a trend with less delay.

entries.title: Zero-Lag Triple EMA (ZLTEMA)
entries.summary: A triple exponential average with progressively faster stages, fed a de-lagged price, for a very responsive trend line.

entries.title: Z-Score (ZSCORE)
entries.summary: How far the current value sits from its rolling mean, measured in standard deviations of the lookback window.

entries.title: One-Sample t-Test (ZTEST)
entries.summary: A rolling t-statistic that asks whether the recent mean of the source sits significantly away from a hypothesized value, such as zero for returns.

entries.title: Displacement Candles Scanner
entries.summary: Counts runs of wide, one-directional candles, labels each run's length when it ends, and can flag the first pull-back to the run's Fibonacci level.

entries.title: Displacement Candles Indicator
entries.summary: Counts runs of large one-way candles, labels each run with its length, and can mark the first pullback to a Fibonacci level of the run.

entries.title: Equal Highs and Lows
entries.summary: Boxes two consecutive swing highs, or two consecutive swing lows, that formed within a small percentage of each other.

entries.title: Equal Highs and Lows with Screener
entries.summary: Boxes pairs of consecutive swing highs or swing lows that print within a set percentage of each other, and lists the latest hits in a table.
