entries.title: External Range Liquidity Static Multi-timeframe (Swing High and Low)
entries.summary: Draws higher timeframe swing highs and lows from three timeframes until price trades through them, and boxes equal highs and equal lows.

entries.title: Fair Value Gap (FVG) Scanner v2
entries.summary: Draws every three-bar fair value gap as a box that trails until price fills it, and marks the bar where a chosen stage of the fill completes.

entries.title: Liquidity Sweep Pattern Scanner
entries.summary: Tracks a zig zag of the last seven swings and flags the bar where the newest swing runs through an earlier swing level after a set shape has formed.

entries.title: Liquidity Void Fill Scanner
entries.summary: Finds wide, full-bodied displacement candles, plots the Fibonacci level inside each one and signals when price retraces back to that level.

entries.title: Liquidity Void Fill
entries.summary: Marks wide, full-bodied displacement candles and signals when price later retraces into the void they left, at a chosen Fibonacci depth of the candle.

entries.title: Liquidity Void Multi-timeframe
entries.summary: Boxes the untraded price gaps between same-direction candles of a chosen timeframe, with a level line that runs right until price returns.

entries.title: Liquidity Void Screener
entries.summary: Boxes the untraded price gaps between candles of the same direction and marks the bars where price crosses back through the newest void level.

entries.title: Market Structure Shift (MSS) Screener
entries.summary: Marks the bar where price closes through the middle of the last three swings against the prevailing structure, boxes the swing range and lists recent shifts in a table.

entries.title: Market Structure Shift (MSS)
entries.summary: Marks the close that breaks back through the middle of the last three swings, boxes the swing range it broke, and flags a one-third retracement into it.

entries.title: Mitigation Block Scanner
entries.summary: Finds the nine-pivot swing pattern of a mitigation block on a zig zag and marks the bar where the close breaks through it, or the later retest of that level.

entries.title: Retracement to Order Block with Screener
entries.summary: Marks an order block in three steps: a range-breaking momentum candle, a close beyond it, and the retracement back to its level, with a table of recent entries.

entries.title: Smart Money Radar
entries.summary: Order blocks, fair value gaps, equal highs and lows, prior day, week and month levels, session ranges and BOS or CHoCH labels in one overlay.

entries.title: Magnetic Zones Multi-timeframe
entries.summary: Projects Fibonacci-spaced support and resistance zones from the previous day, week or month, with optional averages, VWAP and Supertrend.

entries.title: Futures Context
entries.summary: Folds same-time RVOL, realized volatility, session VWAP location, EMA structure and trend quality into one session regime verdict with a confidence score.

entries.title: Futures Levels
entries.summary: A session level map for intraday futures: opening range, initial balance, overnight range, anchored VWAP bands, prior day and week, confluence zones and level states.

entries.title: Futures Profile
entries.summary: A regular-session TPO profile with a developing POC and value area, the initial balance and its extensions, and the previous session's levels.

entries.title: Futures Setups Research
entries.summary: Scores Fair Value Gaps and Order Blocks from the chart and five higher timeframes on a 1-minute futures chart and draws the best qualifying touch as a trade with a stop and 1R to 2R objectives.

entries.title: Futures Setups
entries.summary: Scores Fair Value Gaps and Order Blocks from six timeframes out of 100 and turns the best qualifying touch into a trade plan with a stop and 1R, 1.5R and 2R targets.

entries.title: Options Context
entries.summary: An intraday context score from -100 to 100 that blends trend, session structure, momentum, volume, persistence and higher timeframes, with a confidence line.

entries.title: Options Levels
entries.summary: Scores session, swing, gap, round-number and VWAP levels into clusters and keeps one support and one resistance reaction zone, tracking how price behaves at each.

entries.title: Momentum Investing Setup with Scanner
entries.summary: Flags a bar only when the 250-bar change, RSI, MFI, CCI and a volume surge all agree, with Supertrend on price and mini oscillator curves under the candles.

entries.title: Momentum Investing Setup
entries.summary: Flags a bar only when the 250-bar change, RSI, MFI, CCI and a volume surge all agree, with Supertrend on price and small oscillator panels in price space.

entries.title: RSI Directional Momentum Scanner
entries.summary: An RSI setup scanner: RSI crosses 60 or 40, pulls back, then price breaks the setup candle, with retracement, flip and divergence modes.

entries.title: RSI Directional Momentum
entries.summary: An RSI pane with a three-step breakout scanner on top: RSI breaks 60 or 40, pulls back, then price clears the breaking candle, plus retracement, flip and divergence modes.

entries.title: Option Buying Scalping Setup Scanner
entries.summary: A directional scalping setup that marks long and short bars when Supertrend, an anchored VWAP, MACD and Stochastic all agree, with optional candle, volume and time filters.

entries.title: Option Buying Scalping Setup
entries.summary: A directional scalping setup that marks the bar where VWAP, Supertrend, MACD and Stochastic all agree on one side after a MACD pullback.

entries.title: Sideways Market Skipper Scanner
entries.summary: A Supertrend cross arms a setup, and the signal waits until price breaks a volatility range beyond the crossing close while the ATR is rising.

entries.title: Sideways Market Skipper
entries.summary: Waits out the sideways stretch after a Supertrend cross and signals only when the close breaks a volatility range set from the crossing bar.
